item.title: ‘Jalen Brunson wants…’ – Ex-WNBA star details why New York Knicks are struggling this season
item.description: Photo by David Berding/Getty Images Former WNBA player Chiney Ogwumike names the biggest problem for the New York Knicks. After the New York Knicks won the 2026 NBA Championship, fans expected a solid showing from the franchise in the 2026-27 season as well. However, this season hasn’t been kind to the Knicks, as they are currently the sixth seed in the Eastern Conference with a 9-6 record. As a result, fans are already starting to lose hope for a potential back-to-back NBA Championship run from the team. But what’s the reason behind the Knicks’ early-season struggles? Chiney Ogwumike says the New York Knicks need to change their ‘recipe’ Last season, the Knicks took teams by surprise with their tactics under head coach Mike Brown. Brown’s approach has remained relatively unchanged this season as well. According to former WNBA star Chiney Ogwumike, that’s where the problem lies for the defending NBA champions. “There’s no surprise factor anymore. Like everyone knows that this is a team that can beat anybody, the scouting report’s out, Jalen Brunson wants to close games and I think that you can’t use the same recipe and expect different results. The rest of the Eastern Conference is different. You sort of have to tweak some things,” Ogwumike began. “Now, I know it’s probably going to be sensitive with that starting lineup, but I would give them a little bit more time to sort of ease themselves into that possibility,” she further stated. In simple terms, the ESPN analyst wants coach Brown to experiment with different lineups and tactics, instead of relying on what worked last season. To be fair, the Knicks won the NBA title with those exact tactics, but the off-season has allowed other teams to be well-prepared for them, and the team’s 9-6 record is a perfect reflection of it. item.title: Bob Chesney reveals main message to UCLA amid CFP push
item.description: Darren Yamashita-Imagn Images Bob Chesney reveals main message to UCLA amid CFP push appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The UCLA football Bruins have not been named a national champion since 1954. They have never won 11 games in a single campaign. They won just eight games combined across the previous two seasons. A 10-0 record carries significant weight for alumni, and top-four standing in the Playoff rankings carries even more. This program has completely transformed under Bob Chesney . But the head coach does not care about what the success represents, at least not right now. He is more concerned about how that success is achieved. Ahead of Saturday’s road game versus Michigan , Chesney is stressing the importance of ignoring all the outside praise. Hunger is fueled by a lack of satisfaction. He wants his players to be starving when they brave a rowdy Ann Arbor crowd that has nothing to celebrate except for a potential upset win versus a national title contender. “I said it back when we first got ranked. ‘Look, there’s a little number next to your name right now, and if you want to pay attention to that number, it will very quickly disappear. If you want to pay attention to how you got the number, and the process in which you did to earn that number, then who knows, maybe it could get a little bit better,'” the 2025 Sun Belt Coach of the Year (James Madison) said on SportsCenter with Scott Van Pelt. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “After every single game, I walk in on Sunday morning and just say it doesn’t matter. Get better. Period. You had a bad play? It doesn’t matter. Get better. The next play is about to happen whether you like it or not. The next game is about to happen whether you like it or not, and you can’t let a previous success or failure determine our next success or failure.” Did you run through a brick wall yet? "We can't hold back and let a previous success or failure determine our next success or failure." UCLA head coach Bob Chesney joins @notthefakeSVP ahead of their game against Michigan and speaks on the message to his team 🏈 pic.twitter.com/he9W0NDtl9 — SportsCenter (@SportsCenter) November 21, 2026 Bob Chesney obviously has his players focused on the right things. UCLA football is rising at a meteoric pace , but it will instantly cool off with one loss versus a .500 Michigan squad. Keeping a locker room from getting too high or too low is an essential part of the job. And this man is clearly up to the task. The Bruins can reach that perpetually elusive 11th win, but they will hear Chesney’s “it doesn’t matter speech” if and when they reach that milestone. However, the school and fan base will certainly bask in that historic moment. UCLA-Michigan kicks off at about 3:30 p.m. ET on Saturday. item.title: “He is Such a Hypocrite”: Fans Torch Nick Saban as He Seemingly Changes Tack on Lane Kiffin’s Move to LSU from Ole Miss
item.description: Lane Kiffin and Nick Saban © Imagn Nick Saban was all for giving head coaches their due and supported Lane Kiffin when the former Ole Miss boss decided to head to LSU, but he has seemingly changed course after some poor performances this season for the Tigers. The former Alabama coach said that had Kiffin stayed at Ole Miss, he would have been able to build the team around Trinidad Chambliss. “I think if Lane Kiffin stayed at Ole Miss, they would have been able to build that team around Trinidad Chambliss…I respect Sam Leavitt as a competitor, and he makes a lot of plays…If you could just eliminate his bad plays, LSU would be in a completely different position,” Saban said on the Pat McAfee Show. Fans reacted to Saban’s comments, with one fan saying, “But Saban is the voice that was in Lane’s ear to leave Ole Miss for LSU. He is such a hypocrite. Saban can’t even give Pete Golding an ounce of credit.” Lane Kiffin Spoke About Returning to Tennessee As LSU prepares to play Tennessee on Saturday, Lane Kiffin was asked how it feels to play against his former team. Kiffin referred to the emotionally charged game against Ole Miss this season, when fans turned out in huge numbers to watch him return to his old stomping grounds. “I’m not challenging Tennessee, but I just don’t think you can top that (the atmosphere at Ole Miss),” Kiffin said , per USA Today. “Just the feeling of what that was like, and the anger and hatred, because it was so recent.” Kiffin coached Tennessee in 2009 and went 7-6 with the Vols before leaving to become head coach at USC. item.title: The most bizarre own goal in history 🤯
item.description: The most bizarre own goal in history 🤯 Never seen anything like it... On Friday evening, FC Porto faced third-division side USC Paredes in the fourth round of the Portuguese Cup. The match featured one of the most astonishing own goals in football history. After a save by his goalkeeper, Francisco Moura found himself alone in front of goal with the ball...which he put into his own net with what looked like a pass, making the goal seem almost deliberate. Inexplicable. It was an ordeal for the Portuguese defender, who burst into tears and apologised profusely before the crowd applauded him and his opponents consoled him. A heartwarming moment on the night, especially as Porto eventually won on penalties thanks to three saves from goalkeeper Claudio Ramos. All's well that ends well for the night's unfortunate protagonist. This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence. You can read the original version in 🇫🇷 here.

item.title: “This Claim Is Absolutely Delusional”: Fans Push Back as Tim Tebow Calls LSU “The Most Dangerous Team in the Country” Ahead of Tennessee Clash
item.description: LSU head coach Lane Kiffin. © IMAGN via Reuters Connect LSU is unranked and coming off back-to-back losses, but former Florida quarterback Tim Tebow believes they are still one of the most dangerous teams in college football. The Tigers enter Saturday’s game against No. 9 Tennessee at 6-4 after a 22-21 defeat to Texas last week. Speaking on ESPN, Tebow showed extreme confidence in LSU, despite its recent struggles. “I think they’re the most dangerous team in the country. They’re unranked and maybe one of the top three or four most talented teams in the country,” Tebow said. Tebow’s assessment did not convince many fans on social media. One fan bluntly wrote, “This claim is absolutely delusional.” Another joked, “Does he know it’s not April 1st?!” Urban Meyer Offers a Different Perspective on LSU Urban Meyer’s assessment of the Tigers is very different from that of Tebow’s. Meyer talked about LSU’s motivation after being eliminated from College Football Playoff contention. “They’re out of the College Football Playoff. They’re going to go to some bowl game they don’t want to go to. You’ve got a head coach that may be called out part of his roster. What happens if you have four players on offense whose heads aren’t in the game? So that’s one concern,” he said on The Triple Option podcast. “The best version of LSU, we said this about four weeks ago, could compete and win it all. I don’t think we’re going to see the best version again.” With Tennessee looking to protect its playoff hopes and LSU attempting to finish its season strongly, Saturday’s game promises to be a thriller. item.title: “He Tried to Trade for Him”: NFL Fans React After John Harbaugh’s Viral Response to Colts Cutting QB Daniel Jones
item.description: John Harbaugh © Reuters Connect The Indianapolis Colts have waived quarterback Daniel Jones after an unimpressive performance against the Houston Texans on Thursday night, and it appears the news hit John Harbaugh like a ton of bricks. The New York Giants head coach was asked about Jones at his press conference and appeared stunned, sparking wild reactions on social media. One fan said “he tried to trade for him”, while others wondered whether it might have been an act by Harbaugh. “He tried to trade for him,” the fan wrote. Head Coach Shane Steichen’s Statement on the Colts Cutting Daniel Jones Colts head coach Shane Steichen appreciated Daniel Jones after the franchise waived the QB, expressing his positivity in an official statement. “Can’t say enough good things about Daniel, just the ultimate competitor, ultimate teammate, the toughness that he brought to our football team. Can’t say enough good things about him,” Steichen said, per the NFL website . “I mean, the guy played on a broken leg for us last year for three or four games, snaps his Achilles, came back in eight and a half months, and gave this organization everything he had. Couldn’t be more thankful for the time I had with him.” Jones completed just 12 of 27 passes for 144 yards and one interception on Thursday night, and the writing was on the wall as Anthony Richardson replaced the QB in the final minutes. The Colts play the Giants on Sunday, 29 Nov. in their next NFL game. item.title: Steven Fakult leads Nordonia into OHSAA football state semifinal
item.description: TWINSBURG – The Nordonia football team completed its "Revenge Tour" on Friday, Nov. 20, in dramatic fashion. Senior quarterback Steven Fakult threw five touchdown passes, including one in overtime to senior Dominick Jackson in Nordonia's 35-28 win over Highland in the Division II, Region 5 championship at Twinsburg Tiger Stadium. “That’s what we practice,” Jackson said of the game-winning TD. “We have run that play a thousand times through my 10 years playing football here. So, we just had to put the emotion down and just do what we do best and just go make a play. … Steven is one my best buds. He's the greatest guy. People [at colleges] need to start taking more looks at him. He makes plays. He wins games.” Nordonia (12-1) advanced to play Columbus Bishop Watterson (12-0) in a state semifinal at 7 p.m. Friday, Nov. 27, at a site to be determined by the OHSAA. Nordonia is a state semifinalist for the first time since 2014 when it finished as Division II state runners-up. The Knights were also Division II state runners-up in 2002 and Division II state semifinalists in 2006. Watterson, the Division III state champion in 2024 and 2025, isn't part of the "Revenge Tour," but Highland (11-2) was. Nordonia’s path to a state semifinal included wins over the five teams that defeated the Knights since the start of last season. “You don't really get that many opportunities in high school football, so when you go out there you have to make the most of it, and we are fired up,” Jackson said. North Royalton, Wadsworth and Hudson beat Nordonia in the regular season in 2025, and Walsh Jesuit eliminated the Knights in a regional quarterfinal playoff game last season. Nordonia defeated Hudson, North Royalton and Wadsworth in the regular season in 2026, and eliminated Walsh Jesuit in a regional semifinal. Highland topped Nordonia 23-21 on Sept. 11 before the Knights reversed that outcome Friday in the postseason. “It all starts in the offseason,” Nordonia senior linebacker-running back-wide receiver Karsen Fisher said. “… So, this offseason it was all forget that — we are going to go beat your butt during this season, and we did that. Hudson and Wadsworth were the big ones. I had never beaten either of them until this season. "It was my personal duty to beat everybody we lost to. I made sure to keep the energy at practice, and this week especially with Highland. This is a regional freaking championship, man.” Jackson caught two of Fakult’s TD passes — a 35-yard strike in the second quarter and a 17-yard strike in overtime. Fakult threw a 27-yard TD pass to senior Grant Kaminski on a 4th-and-10 and a 5-yard TD pass to junior Jamison Elerick in the third quarter and a 1-yard TD pass to senior CJ Mayes on 4th-and-goal play. “We saw a cover 2, cover 4 type of defense, which is really kind of unorthodox for them,” Fakult said of the final TD pass to Jackson. “Usually it's been cover 3, cover 1. So, I was a little bit surprised. It was great to get that pass off.” Fakult

item.title: Skip Bayless names ‘the best player’ in the NFL right now
item.description: Photo by Frank Jansky/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Skip Bayless has called Josh Allen the best player in the NFL while speaking about why he should be the MVP ahead of Joe Burrow. Allen previously won the award in 2024 and is in the midst of another impressive season with his Buffalo Bills 8-1 ahead of their Week 11 game. The Bills quarterback has some strong competition for the award this year, including from Joe Burrow. But while Bayless thinks the Cincinnati Bengals star is ‘the ultimate system quarterback’, he is of the opinion that ‘Allen has revolutionised’ the QB role and is ‘the best player in football and he should be the MVP’. Speaking on First Take, he said: “Josh Allen has revolutionised the quarterback position in ways I never thought I would see in my lifetime because he has scored 11 rushing touchdowns in the red zone. He’s become the Derrick Henry of quarterbacks. He is just simply unstoppable. “While Joe Burrow is the ultimate system quarterback, almost always throwing it on time, Josh Allen’s offence is mostly backyard. I think he makes up almost every play. He’s getting away with a running back who weighs 190 pounds running between the tackles. “It is all Josh Allen. He’s the best player in football and he should be the MVP.” How Josh Allen and Joe Burrow compare Allen currently has a better record with the Bills this season but Burrow does lead him in some key stats. The Bengals quarterback has the second-most passing yards in the NFL (2,795), which is considerably more than Josh (2,223). He also has a much higher completion rate (74.7%) compared to Allen (65.0%) and has more passing yards per game (310.6 vs 247.0). But as Bayless suggested, the Bills player is a pretty unique style of quarterback as he actually leads the league in rushing touchdowns (11) alongside Jahmyr Gibbs. Burrow is the joint-closest quarterback to matching Allen on that front but he only has three rushing touchdowns. It remains to be seen who will be crowned MVP this season but both players should still be in contention, and while Skip may be supporting Allen’s claim, others disagree. Among them is Tom Brady, who says it’s ‘pretty obvious’ Burrow is the best quarterback in the league. item.title: “Spoken Like a Man Who May Want a Job One Day”: Fans Aren’t Convinced as Former Colts Star Defends Carlie Irsay-Gordon Amid Criticism of Her Leadership
item.description: Indianapolis Colts owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon walks on the field before the game against the Houston Texans at Reliant Stadium. © Troy Taormina-Imagn Images Carlie Irsay-Gordon has come under increasing scrutiny as the Indianapolis Colts continue to struggle through a disappointing season. Following the team’s embarrassing 26-3 loss to the Houston Texans, fans and several analysts shared their disappointment with the owner. However, former Colts star Stephon Gilmore has pushed back against those criticisms, expressing confidence in Irsay-Gordon’s leadership. Gilmore defended the Colts owner on social media, saying he has personally seen her involved in team meetings and believes she understands football better than many give her credit for. “Yall have to chill on Carlie Irsay. I’ve seen her in meetings. She knows more ball than a lot of so-called football people. She’s very passionate about the game and the Colts. I’ve seen her in meetings. She will get the @Colts right in due time. Watch,” he wrote. However, Gilmore’s defense did not convince everyone, and several fans questioned his comments and the Colts’ recent decisions. One fan wrote, “Spoken like a man who may want a job one day down the road.” “Rejecting trade offers for Daniel Jones only to release him right after the deadline must be some kind of 4D chess I don’t understand,” another wrote. “Look man she needs to have taken the picks she dropped the ball on this one and she HAS GOT to wear the blame,” one fan wrote. “Some 4D chess there, not trading DJ before the deadline,” another wrote. “Good for her, but any owner who thinks their presence on the sideline isn’t a distraction is a problem. Regardless if they are male or female,” another added. Analyst Blames Carlie Irsay-Gordon for Colts’ Collapse NFL analyst Michael Holley delivered a harsh assessment of Irsay-Gordon’s leadership on Pro Football Talk after the Houston loss. “This is gonna sound crazy. But their owner ruined their season. We can say how bad they are and that stat and how bad they are and they get a prize for that. They still have three wins. They went into a game last night with the Houston Texans, who also had three wins. So it’s not like we were watching the Jaguars against the Titans. We were watching two three-win teams last night,” Holley said. He argued that the decision to fire general manager Chris Ballard and to trade away several key players derailed Indianapolis’ season. He continued questioning whether the coaching staff could still effectively manage players and end the season on a good note. The Colts have struggled significantly this season; against Houston, they recorded just 167 total yards. With the franchise facing questions about its direction, Irsay-Gordon has very little time to make changes and turn things around to silence the critics. item.title: Celtic v St Mirren – This is the day when Kasper Hogh puts one away
item.description: Celtic v St Mirren – This is the day when Kasper Hogh puts one away Kasper Hogh will be a vital player today, he will be one of the first names on the team sheet, and with good reason… Kasper Hogh of Celtic scores the opening goal only for VAR to rule it out for a foul in the build up during the Scottish Premiership match between Celtic and Kilmarnock at Celtic Park on November 08, 2026. (Photo by Ian MacNicol/Getty Images) Kasper Hogh is a player who is under a huge amount of scrutiny at the moment due to his three month run without a goal. The £11 million man hasn’t hit the back of the net since his first half hat trick at Rugby Park at the beginning of August, and it’s understandably being used against him due to him being a centre forward, one that the club shelled out a record £11 million for. Kasper Hogh of Celtic is challenged by Emmanuel Agbadou of Besiktas JK during the UEFA Europa League match between Celtic FC and Besiktas JK at Celtic Park on November 05, 2026. (Photo by Ian MacNicol/Getty Images) Despite his goal drought, and the criticism that comes with it, Kasper hasn’t allowed it to get him down, and the Danish international has put in some impressive performances as he shows there’s more to his game than just being a poacher. He was however signed to score goals, and he did find the net once again against Kilmarnock a fortnight ago, only to see it cruelly ruled out by VAR for a foul by Mika Baur in the build up. I have no doubts that Kasper will start today, In fact I’d be willing to place a small wager that he’ll be in the starting XI when the teams are announced later this afternoon. Kasper Hogh of Celtic during the UEFA Europa League match between Celtic FC and Besiktas JK at Celtic Park on November 05, 2026. (Photo by Ian MacNicol/Getty Images) He’s a player who is vital to the way we play, especially in the rough and tumble of the Scottish Premiership. The amount of running, and space Kasper makes, as well as finding his team mates with a pass often goes unnoticed due to his much publicised goal drought, and it’s a trait that serves us well in an attacking sense. Kasper also offers a huge physical presence and isn’t easily brushed off the ball, yet another key quality in the top flight of Scottish football. 9th September 2026; McDiarmid Park, Scottish Premiership St Johnstone versus Celtic; Kasper Hogh of Celtic tries to rouse the fans. Photo Vagelis Georgariou If we are to get a positive result today then we require our best players on the field, and Kasper certainly fits into that category. Today could indeed be the day he ends that long goal drought and how the big man will celebrate! item.title: 2027: We’re not joining your opposition coalition, PDP tells Lukman
item.description: …Snubs November 30 summit, declares Wike’s Rainbow alliance its only coalition By Luminous Jannamike, Abuja The Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) has rejected claims that it has joined the opposition Coalition for Democracy being promoted by former National Vice Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Salihu Lukman, declaring that it will not attend the coalition’s November 30 summit. The party said it had not entered into any alliance with the coalition, authorised anyone to represent it at the summit or agreed to be bound by any decision taken in its name. It maintained that its only recognised coalition arrangement was the Rainbow Coalition, backed by its National Leader, Nyesom Wike. The position was contained in a statement signed by the PDP National Publicity Secretary, Hon. Jungudo Haruna Mohammed, who said those being presented as the party’s representatives were expelled members with no authority to speak or act on its behalf. Jungudo said the individuals’ claims to the party’s leadership and representation had suffered defeats at the Federal High Court, Court of Appeal and Supreme Court. He added that the courts had issued orders restraining Kabiru Tanimu Turaki, SAN, and his associates from parading themselves as PDP leaders, while imposing financial penalties exceeding N100 million over alleged abuses of court processes and frivolous litigation. Questioning Lukman’s continued engagement with the individuals, Jungudo said, “It is therefore astonishing that Mr Salihu Lukman, who ought to be sufficiently informed about the legal status and recognised leadership of the PDP, would continue to engage these individuals and use them as a basis for associating the party with his so-called Toronto Coalition.” Describing the proposed arrangement as a political project built on misrepresentation, the PDP declared it ‘dead on arrival’, particularly because those being presented as its representatives lacked the authority to speak on its behalf. The party also threatened legal action against Lukman, his associates and other promoters of the Coalition for Democracy if they continued to use its name and institutional identity in their political activities. “The party will not hesitate to pursue appropriate legal action against any person or group that continues to unlawfully associate the PDP with this arrangement,” Jungudo warned. Reiterating its position, the party said the Rainbow Coalition, in line with Wike’s political direction and directives, remained its only recognised coalition arrangement. It consequently urged Nigerians, political stakeholders, members and supporters, as well as media organisations, to disregard reports linking its national headquarters at Wadata Plaza, Abuja, to the November 30 summit or any other political arrangement being promoted by Lukman and his associates. “The PDP will not allow its identity to be hijacked, its institutional authority misrepresented or its political interests compromised by individuals who

item.title: Missing Newcastle United home matches
item.description: The Mag Pod Jamie Simon Hutch Watching Game St James' Park Newcastle United First off, I need to start with an apology to anyone coming to The Mag to read my report on whatever happens/has happened against Arsenal , I have decided to allow the editor to flex his squad strength due to my not being there today, missing Newcastle United home matches is, for me at least, a difficult business. I can already imagine some reading this are flabbergasted that someone with a ticket for a game against the Premier League champions would allow themselves to be otherwise occupied when they would crawl over broken all sorts to be there at any time. The thing is, I’m a bit of a victim of poor prediction skills, as a look at any of my recent accas will confirm. A few of my close mates were after arranging a meet up and a poll appeared in the WhatsApp group giving a choice of three weekends. One option was next week when I’m in Brighton, another was the untouchable territory of derby weekend and the remaining option was the Gunners at home. I took a punt and committed to this weekend, knowing that if the game was shifted to Sunday (or any other mad weekend kick off that wasn’t Saturday) I’d be able to get to it, convincing myself we’d be the Sunday warm up to Liverpool v Man Utd. So, it came to pass that wasn’t to be. So what do you do? Ditch your old mates and head to the game, or give someone else a chance with your ticket? Again, opinions will be polarised as some commentators will doubtless be about to say that they would chop their hand off with a rusty spoon to be in that ground, whereas many others will have found themselves in the position where they choose life over NUFC. I haven’t made this kind of miscalculation very often, with most of my absences from Newcastle United home matches being early season when it’s clashed with a holiday. Memories of enduring last season’s defeat to Liverpool in a bar at Disneyland Paris with an obnoxious cockney red mouthing off behind me are not amongst my most magical. It’s maybe a bit easier to swallow missing a defeat though. I’ll always remember when my youngest son was born and I confidently thought to myself he’d arrive in plenty of time for me to get to the game with Norwich in about six days. Mrs S saw it quite differently and her reaction to the prospect of me leaving her with a newborn and two toddlers as she recovered from a c-section was, if I’m honest, a bit over the top. I stayed at home and checked online to catch the news of Dwight Gayle’s 96th minute hat-trick goal sealing an incredible 4-3 comeback win. Honestly, during the whole Mike Ashley era it was a bit easier to give things a swerve. I remember hauling myself out of the house on a freezing Wednesday evening full of cold. After standing waiting for a bus that never came I had a word with myself and trudged off back to bed, deciding I could do without that 1-1 draw with Burnley. item.title: Trent, Bellingham to start | Predicted Real Madrid line-up against Celta Vigo
item.description: Trent, Bellingham to start | Predicted Real Madrid line-up against Celta Vigo After more than a month away from the Santiago Bernabeu, Real Madrid return to their home turf for La Liga matchday 13, where they will face Celta Vigo in what is expected to be a challenging fixture. Jose Mourinho and Real Madrid will be pleased with how their players fared in the international break and return unscathed. Especially Vinicius Junior, who seems to have found his footing after a tough start to the season. With that being said, this is how Real Madrid is expected to line-up against Celta Vigo. Predicted Real Madrid lineup-up against Celta Vigo GK: Thibaut Courtois The Belgian shot-stopper signed a contract renewal until 2028 with the club, keeping the world’s best keeper at Real Madrid for another season. Just 4 clean sheets in 11 league matches is not really up to his mark and the veteran will look to add to his tally tonight. RB: Trent Alexander-Arnold Trent has not been a consistent starter under Jose Mourinho, who prefers either Fede Valverde or Denzel Dumfries. But tonight presents an opportunity for the Englishman to solidify his chances. CB: Antonio Rudiger The veteran defender is expected to replace Ibrahima Konate, who is expected to be rested for this fixture. Rudiger has looked vulnerable at times this season, but his never-say-die attitude is what Mourinho wants in a player. CB: Dean Huijsen Has enjoyed an amazing season so far, despite the red card in the Madrid derby. The Portuguese manager has taken a liking to him and is an important part of the squad. LB: Alvaro Carreras On average, the Spaniard has featured in 9 matches this season and played 39 minutes on average. Cucurella’s emergence has sidelined Carreras but he will hope to perform and give another selection headache to Mourinho. CM: Aurelien Tchouameni Ever since the El Clasico, Tchouameni has proven to be a pivotal player in this squad and, along with Bernardo Silva, provides the solidity Real Madrid requires in the midfield CM: Bernardo Silva His arrival offered the Los Blancos experience in midfield, which they have lacked since Luka Modric’s departure. Since the Roma match, Bernardo has been a regular starter. RW: Arda Guler Despite facing defeats in the international break, Guler carried his form into national colours and recorded a goal and an assist. He is Real Madrid’s present and future, with the club renewing his contract until 2032. CAM: Jude Bellingham Undoubtedly the first name on the team sheet for Real Madrid or England. Was at his best against Spain and Croatia, completing a couple of assists and continues to take the world by storm. item.title: Baldini advises Camarda ‘father to son’ and has great expectations for Bartesaghi: ‘A luxury’
item.description: Baldini advises Camarda ‘father to son’ and has great expectations for Bartesaghi: ‘A luxury’ Italy U21s head coach Silvio Baldini says that he has spoken to Francesco Camarda ‘like father-to-son’ and has tipped both Alphadjo Cisse and Davide Bartesaghi to reach the highest heights in the professional game: ‘If I were the coach of any Serie A club, I would take him with me’. Baldini shared his thoughts on Milan’s cohort of young Italian talents in an interview with La Gazzetta dello Sport, published on Saturday. Baldini talks Cisse, Camarda and Bartesaghi: ‘A luxury for the U21s’ The Azzurrini head coach says that he is impressed with the development and maturity that Cisse has shown over the last year. ITALY – OCTOBER 28: Alphadjo Cisse of AC Milan celebrates scoring his team’s first goal during the Serie A match between AC Milan and Bologna FC at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on October 28, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) It has been a rapid rise to the top for the Rossoneri winger, who was playing in Serie B with Catanzaro six months ago, has already been fast-tracked through the Italy U21 side and was called up to the senior national side by Roberto Mancini earlier this month. “Compared to a year ago, I see a completely different guy, stronger, more mature and more prepared with a lot more self-esteem,” Baldini told La Gazzetta dello Sport . “He has Milan to thank for taking him from Catanzaro in Serie B, believing in him and giving him an opportunity to play consistently. If he moves up to the national team and does well, even better.” Baldini credited Milan with scouting and developing Cisse, but La Gazzetta dello Sport suggested that it is Baldini who discovered that Cisse could be equally as effective through the middle as he is off the wing. A humble Baldini shrugged off those suggestions: “After analysing the training sessions, there were lots of situations where he managed to score by attacking space from depth. If he can do it off the left and right flanks, it means he can do it from the centre as well. “But still, the credit goes to the staff who had this insight, who understood that Cisse could be useful to our game plan in that role. I try to be honest and meritocratic in my decisions.” Baldini was then asked for his thoughts on Camarda. Tipped for greatness from the age of 15 onwards, some feel that the now-18-year-old has stalled in his development and that he has had a lack of opportunities in the Milan first-team. PERTH, AUSTRALIA – AUGUST 05: Aleksandar Stankovic of FC Internazionale turns with the ball during the pre-season match between AC Milan and FC Internazionale at Optus Stadium on August 05, 2026 in Perth, Australia. (Photo by James Worsfold/Getty Images) “I can only talk about the things that we do together,” said Baldini. “I spoke to him at length, dedicated some time to him, had him explain his concerns, his fear of not being able to express himself in the way that he would like. “I responded by tellin

item.title: UGA football commit got drink of water, went to bed and never woke up, family says
item.description: ‘Everything a coach wants:’ UGA football commit dies after medical emergency Rabun Gap-Nacoochee School The family of a University of Georgia football commit is sharing new details about the moments before his death. Marcellus Young Casario , known to friends and teammates as “Mar,” died after a sudden medical emergency, Rabun Gap-Nacoochee School confirmed earlier this month. [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] He was a boarding student who came to the Rabun Gap school from Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada, as a junior. He planned to graduate in December and enroll at UGA in January. His family released a statement to 247 Sports saying that he had not been feeling well. They say that on the day he died, he woke up early, got a drink of water from a water fountain, returned to bed and never woke up. “As many of you know, we lost our beloved son and brother on Friday. We so much appreciate the support and prayers we have received from so many people. It means the world to our family. Thank you. While we are trying to navigate all of this with as much privacy as possible, we know there are many wonderful people in Marcellus’ life who cared so much about him and are wondering how this could happen. Unfortunately we do not yet know. We do know Marcellus did not take his own life and did not have the Covid vaccine. We also know he was not feeling well, woke up early Friday, got a drink of water from the water fountain, went back to bed and never woke up. We are very grateful to the school and law enforcement for their support and ongoing investigation. We have full confidence that the school and law enforcement will do everything in their power to determine what happened. We remain steadfast in our faith and know that we will see Marcellus again. He had an incredible future that he had worked hard for with many sacrifices along the way. Thank you again for your support and prayers.” Family of Marcellus Young Casario They say the school and police are investigating Young Casario’s death and are working to learn what happened. “He was everything a coach wants in a player. Mar truly embodied our mission to ‘love one another,’” Head Football Coach Derek White said. “He was known for his relentless dedication, and his journey as a student-athlete was marked by hard work and a true brotherhood with his teammates.” “Mar brought light, faith, and character to everything he did, and his absence is a tremendous void in our close-knit community,” Head of School Bob Ahrens said. item.title: PREVIEW | Werder Bremen and Hamburg prepare for Nordderby battle
item.description: PREVIEW | Werder Bremen and Hamburg prepare for Nordderby battle One of German football’s most historic rivalries returns this Sunday as Werder Bremen host Hamburg at the Weserstadion in the 111th Bundesliga edition of the Nordderby. With just three points separating the two clubs, the encounter promises to be one of Matchday 10’s most fascinating fixtures. Bremen enter the match sixth with 15 points, while Hamburg sit 11th with 12. Both clubs have enjoyed encouraging spells this season, making the derby particularly significant beyond their historic rivalry. Bremen’s home advantage and Füllkrug’s influence Daniel Thioune – who signed an extension 24 hours prior to the derby – has transformed Bremen into a more competitive side, with their seven-match unbeaten run ending against VfB Stuttgart before the international break. The Weserstadion has become a major advantage. Bremen remain unbeaten there this season, collecting 10 points from four matches. Niclas Füllkrug has been instrumental in their resurgence, scoring nine Bundesliga goals in nine appearances. Hamburg, meanwhile, have struggled away from home, losing four of their five matches on the road. However, their recent 3-1 victory over Borussia Mönchengladbach demonstrated their attacking potential, particularly through Miro Muheim’s dangerous long-range shooting. More than just three points The Nordderby also presents an intriguing managerial storyline. Thioune previously coached Hamburg and worked alongside current Hamburg head coach Merlin Polzin at Osnabrück before their paths crossed again in Hamburg. History favours Bremen, who have won eight of their previous nine Bundesliga home encounters against their northern rivals. Last season, however, both clubs won their respective home derbies, highlighting the unpredictable nature of this fixture. For Bremen, victory would reinforce their European ambitions and demonstrate that their impressive start is sustainable. Hamburg, meanwhile, have an opportunity to move level on points with their rivals and strengthen their position in the Bundesliga. Regardless of their respective league positions, the Nordderby represents something much bigger than three points. It is a contest shaped by history, regional pride and the desire to establish supremacy in northern Germany. With both teams showing encouraging signs this season, Sunday’s encounter has all the ingredients to deliver another memorable chapter in one of the Bundesliga’s greatest rivalries. GGFN | Felipe

item.title: George Russell throws the book at Max Verstappen again after Las Vegas incident
item.description: George Russell reignited his bitter rivalry with Max Verstappen by accusing the Dutchman of screwing him over and walking around as if he is “bigger and better than everyone else”. Russell’s stinging remarks arrived after he banged wheels with Verstappen in final practice for the Las Vegas Grand Prix. Verstappen angrily raised his middle finger at Russell from his Red Bull cockpit following the clash which landed him with a warning from the stewards. Despite the flashpoint, Verstappen will start from pole position for Saturday’s race after he took advantage of Kimi Antonelli’s five-place grid drop for an engine penalty. Russell qualified third but also moves up a place to form a tantalising front row with his nemesis in Sin City. Russell was gearing up for a fast lap in the final running prior to qualifying when Verstappen raced ahead of him, disregarding a so-called gentleman’s agreement. Verstappen then moved under braking at Turn 14 with Russell forced to launch his Mercedes underneath the Dutchman’s Red Bull – the two drivers then exchanged tyre rubber. Verstappen said Russell drove him into the barriers. “There’s nothing in the rules to say you cannot overtake someone who is starting a lap, but when you do this, you are screwing this person over,” said Russell. “He (Verstappen) does this week in, week out with many drivers, and everybody accepts it. I’m not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this and walk around like they’re bigger and better than everyone else.” The two drivers have history. Russell claimed Verstappen threatened to “put my f****** head in the wall” following a disagreement in Qatar two years ago. Verstappen said at the time that he had lost “all respect” for Russell. The Dutchman had also previously referred to the Mercedes driver as “Princess George”. Verstappen and Russell will start on the front row after Kimi Antonelli’s penalty Both men were asked about the practice dispute in Saturday’s post-qualifying news conference. An angry Verstappen said “nothing happened” before hastily dropping the microphone. Russell continued: “No confusion. It was pretty clear what happened.” Russell ended up just 0.073 seconds behind Verstappen, knowing that a tow off team-mate Antonelli’s Mercedes would probably have propelled him to top spot. Toto Wolff hinted ahead of this weekend’s race that Mercedes – with both drivers’ and constructors’ titles in the bag – would throw their weight behind Russell, who is 17 points behind Verstappen, to finish second in the world championship. In qualifying, Russell called on Mercedes to deploy Antonelli ahead of him for his final throw of the dice for pole. But the British driver’s request fell on deaf ears. Instead, it was Antonelli who benefitted from a slipstream to land pole by nearly three tenths. However, the Italian’s grid sanction drops him to sixth and hands the advantage to Verstappen and Red Bull. “Obviously, it is still important if you have a grid penalty to start as high

item.description: Real Madrid vs Celta Vigo: Match preview | La Liga With the culmination of the international break, Real Madrid returns to the Santiago Bernabeu after four matches away from home and shall lock horns against 12th-placed Celta Vigo in La Liga match day 13. Last time Real Madrid played at the Bernabeu was a month ago, when they rattled RB Leipzig in the UEFA Champions League and completed four consecutive away wins. Does Vinicius Junior make a return or will Yan Diomande keep his place? (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) Brazilian winger Vinicius Junior’s suspension came to end after the final whistle against Valencia and is now in line to make it to the starting line up against Celta Vigo. The 26-year-old enjoyed a fabulous international break, wherein he scored 5 goals across 2 matches and will hope to carry his form into Real Madrid colours. However, Yan Diomande has clearly proven that he is starter material and has wreaked havoc after a slow start to his stint as a Los Blancos player. Other than this selection dilemma, Fede Valverde, Ibrahima Konate and Marc Cucurella are expected to be rested for this fixture. This presents an opportunity for players like Trent Alexander-Arnold and Alvaro Carreras to make a case for themselves – especially Trent – as a player of Trent’s quality would certainly not be warming the bench at any other club. Arda Guler carried his fantastic form into the international break as well, albeit in a losing cause. Still, the Turkish player continues to grow and was granted a contract extension until 2032. Speaking of Celta Vigo, it is a surprise that they sit at 12th on the table, considering the team has completed just 2 victories in 12 matches, along with 7 draws and 3 defeats. The away side has conceded and scored the exact same number of goals (10), which may signify a low block being employed against a Real Madrid attack in red-hot form. Goal scoring has never been an issue for Kylian Mbappe; hence, Jose Mourinho’s men will be eager to continue their great form and extend their winning streak to 9 matches at the Santiago Bernabeu.

item.title: ‘It Really Limits Draymond (Green)‘s Impact,’ ‘There’s No Question’ — Warriors HC Steve Kerr Pinpoints Glaring Drop-Off Without Stephen Curry Amid 5-Game Skid
item.description: Oct 11, 2024; San Francisco, California, USA; Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry (center) is flanked by head coach Steve Kerr and forward Draymond Green as he is presented his gold medal for his performance for Team USA at the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris before taking on the Sacramento Kings at Chase Center. © D. Ross Cameron-Imagn Images The Golden State Warriors’ losing streak reached five games Thursday night, as the Memphis Grizzlies rolled to a 126-98 win at FedExForum. The skid began the night Stephen Curry got hurt, and all five losses have come on the road. In the four games he has missed entirely, the Warriors have not reached 100 points once, and Warriors head coach Steve Kerr was candid about what has gone missing. Stephen Curry’s Absence Leaves Steve Kerr, Warriors Searching for Solutions In a recent appearance on “95.7 The Game,” Kerr broke down how Curry’s absence has altered the offense and what it has meant for Draymond Green in particular. Curry exited the 115-108 loss to the Houston Rockets with 6:25 to go in the first quarter, having scored 3 points on 1-of-3 shooting. A day later, the Warriors announced that an MRI had confirmed an oblique abdominal tear and that he would be re-evaluated in two weeks. The injury sidelined the franchise star in the middle of a productive start, as Curry had started all 10 games he played, averaging 27.8 points and 3.9 assists while shooting 50% from the field and 45.7% from three. The team’s November 12 update set Curry’s re-evaluation for two weeks out. That 7-point loss in Houston remains the closest game of the streak. The Warriors then fell to the San Antonio Spurs, New Orleans Pelicans, Dallas Mavericks, and Grizzlies by at least 21 points apiece, shooting a combined 40-of-154 from three across those four games, about 26%. Kerr explained how much Curry’s absence changes things for Golden State and Green: “It really does change everything. And look, Draymond’s aware of that. Steph’s aware of that. So am I. We matched every one of their minutes together in the early part of the season until Steph went out, and it makes sense.” The approach rests on what the pair still creates together. “The two of them remain elite together offensively … but also just when you watch them, the connection, all the tricks, all the things they’ve learned,” Kerr said . “They play the most beautiful two-man game.” READ MORE: ‘It’s Not Easy to Come Into the NBA’ – Steve Kerr Gets Blunt On Yaxel Lendeborg Breaking Onto the Scene Amid Stephen Curry’s Absence Kerr then turned to the flip side, which Golden State has lived with for more than a week: “But when Steph goes out, it really limits Draymond’s impact offensively. There’s no question, and so we’re trying to sort through that and figure it out. And the last few games have been tough for us trying to do so. We have a lot of work ahead of us, and we’re confident that we can find that balance. And we gotta find some combinations that are clicking.” Thursda

item.title: Max Verstappen shares theory on Ferrari's lack of top speed in F1 2026
item.description: Motorsport photo Although Max Verstappen was not entirely satisfied with his second-fastest time in qualifying for the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix – pointing to a mysterious issue with the RB22 – a glance at Ferrari shows that things could have been considerably worse. For the first time since Imola 2025, the Scuderia saw both cars eliminated in Q2, after which Lewis Hamilton explained that floor damage and deployment issues had hampered him. He estimated that the missing section of the floor had cost him three to four tenths, while the deployment issue had cost him another six tenths. Read Also: Lewis Hamilton reveals Ferrari F1 car damage after Las Vegas Q2 exit That said, Ferrari already knew beforehand that the Las Vegas circuit would pose a considerable challenge for the SF-26. This is partly related to deliberate design choices. Ferrari runs a smaller turbo than most other power unit manufacturers, which gave the Maranello-based team an advantage off the line, particularly at the start of this year, but also has implications for outright power. Ferrari has received two ADUO tokens, meaning that, according to FIA measurements, the Italian manufacturer was between 2% and 4% down on the best internal combustion engine on the grid, Red Bull's unit. In Las Vegas, that is particularly painful, as clipping kicks in on the long straight and F1 drivers then have to rely solely on the internal combustion engine's power for a certain period. This partly explains why Ferrari is lacking so much top speed, although Verstappen sees another contributing factor. "They are obviously lacking top speed, but that has to do with the way they have designed their exhaust blowing as well. Because if you look at Haas, it's much less of an issue on the straight," Verstappen said when Motorsport.com asked him about Ferrari's disastrous qualifying session. "It's always a combination of how much downforce you want to have and how much power you're willing to sacrifice for it. The bigger you make that thing in front of the exhaust, the more power you lose. So to some extent, it's obviously in their own hands as well." Charles Leclerc, Ferrari Charles Leclerc, Ferrari Verstappen is referring to Ferrari's exhaust wing, a concept the Scuderia has pioneered this year. It helps generate additional downforce, but Verstappen believes it can also become an extra handicap on the long straights of tracks such as Las Vegas. "At a circuit like this, it can indeed be a major handicap. So perhaps you have to adapt a little to that, but that's obviously something they have to figure out for themselves!" Red Bull, meanwhile, has made significant strides on energy-poor circuits. At the start of this year, efficiency at such venues was still a weakness, particularly compared to Mercedes , but Red Bull Ford Powertrains has gained a great deal of knowledge in that area over the course of the season. item.title: LPGA Tour introduce ‘aggressive’ new solution to stop slow play
item.description: Photo by Patrick Smith/Getty Images The LPGA Tour is tackling pace of play head-on. It’s one of the biggest issues fans have with the modern game, as players are often taking around six hours to complete their rounds. And while the PGA Tour has often been criticized for not taking action to speed up the pace of play, the LPGA Tour is attempting to find solutions. Their latest move is to fine any player who has been put on the clock over 35 times in a year $35,000. That’s an extreme measure, considering the previous threshold was 40 holes, and the previous fine was $5,000. Under the new policy, the maximum time allowed for a single shot also drops from 70 seconds to 60 seconds, and players will pay $2,000 for a first offense, $4,000 for a second, and $8,000 for a third. Delays of six to 15 seconds still bring a one-stroke penalty plus a fine, while delays of 16 seconds or more carry a two-stroke penalty and a fine. LPGA Tour Commissioner Craig Kessler explained how the tour came to this new policy. LPGA Tour Commissioner explains new pace of play policy This new pace-of-play policy is a positive step for the LPGA Tour as it looks to speed up the game, and what’s even more encouraging is that the players are also invested in fixing the issue. How do we know that? Well, the players came up with the solution in the first place. That’s according to Kessler, who said on SiriusXM Radio: “The good news is we started with our fans, and the insight from fans is that pace of play matters. Fans want to see us play faster. We brought that to our players, and we actually have a pace-of-play committee. “And the beautiful thing here is it’s the players who developed the policy. They’re the ones that we understand the importance of playing faster. We understand what are the levers that we can pull to help bring that to life. “And they’re the ones who created the policy that we rolled out to frankly, a decent amount of applause from our players on Tuesday. “I’m very excited to see the policy implemented. If it works as intended, fantastic, and of course if we need to learn and adapt as we go then we’ll do just that.” This isn’t the only step the LPGA Tour has taken. Unlike the PGA Tour, the LPGA has enforced two-stroke penalties on players this season, taking action on Yealimi Noh and Carlota Ciganda and ultimately costing them victories. Kessler spoke about those instances: “There are two players this season that we have addressed two-stroke penalties to, and they actually lost the tournament on Sunday. And by the way, we didn’t do it for that reason, but the reality is, when you’ve got a policy, if you want players to take that seriously, you have to enforce it. “Those are tough calls, and sometimes leadership requires you to make unpopular decisions. But I’m proud of our rules team for sticking to the policy we put in place. And for what it’s worth, you spend a minute on social and look at the fans’ reaction, I think fans are very pleased to see how seriously w

item.title: Le iniziative per la Giornata Internazionale per l'eliminazione della violenza sulle donne
item.description: Le iniziative per la Giornata Internazionale per l'eliminazione della violenza sulle donne Come ogni anno il 25 novembre sarà la Giornata Internazionale per l'eliminazione della violenza sulle donne e come di consueto il calcio italiano si schiera per opporsi e combattere ogni forma di violenza e sopruso nei confronti delle donne. Tante le iniziative previste sui campi di Serie A, Serie A femminile e Serie C, che coinvolgeranno direttamente anche l'Inter. Lega Calcio Serie A e WeWorld hanno rinnovato anche quest'anno il proprio impegno, promuovendo la 10ª edizione della campagna di sensibilizzazione nazionale #UNROSSOALLAVIOLENZA. Diverse le attività previste in occasione della 12ª giornata del massimo campionato italiano: prima di Atalanta-Inter verrà letto un messaggio al pubblico da parte dello speaker, mentre i calciatori e gli ufficiali di gara entreranno in campo con un segno rosso dipinto sulla guancia , simbolo che richiama il cartellino rosso per dare un forte segnale di vicinanza a tutte le donne vittime di abusi e sostenerle nel percorso di fuoriuscita dalla violenza, per combattere insieme la paura che vivono ogni giorno, mentre le bambine e i bambini che accompagneranno i calciatori e gli arbitri sul terreno di gioco durante il cerimoniale di gara indosseranno la divisa dedicata alla campagna #unrossoallaviolenza . I capitani avranno una fascia speciale , dedicata all'iniziativa: inoltre, in ogni stadio il podio porta pallone, l’arco di allineamento e la lavagna luminosa per le sostituzioni saranno personalizzati con l’adesivo dell’iniziativa. item.title: NFL Analyst Already Telling 2 Teams To Pay Attention to Puka Nacua if Rams Let Star WR Walk in Free Agency
item.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua. Puka Nacua has become one of the Los Angeles Rams’ most important offensive players, but his future with the team is no longer a straightforward contract question. A season-ending knee procedure, an NFL suspension, and the absence of an extension have complicated the situation heading into 2027. With the possibility of Nacua reaching free agency now part of the discussion, FOX Sports analyst Jason McIntyre has already identified two teams that could make a move for the All-Pro receiver. Jason McIntyre Names Raiders and Dolphins as Potential Puka Nacua Destinations McIntyre believes the Las Vegas Raiders and Miami Dolphins should monitor Nacua’s situation if the Rams decide not to retain him. Speaking about potential destinations, he pointed to both teams’ needs at wide receiver and their quarterback situations. “I’ll put two teams out there now for Puka next year with quarterbacks on the cheap. Obviously, Fernando Mendoza and the Raiders have no wide receiver room at all. He would be a great No. 1,” McIntyre said. Las Vegas selected Mendoza with the No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft. With the rookie on his first contract, the Raiders could have the financial flexibility to pursue an established receiver. Nacua would give Mendoza a primary target as the franchise builds its offense around its young quarterback. McIntyre also mentioned Miami, which could select a quarterback in the 2027 draft. The Dolphins have their own need for a leading receiver, making Nacua a potential offensive centerpiece for a new quarterback. “And keep an eye on the Miami Dolphins, who will be adding a lot, probably a quarterback in the draft, and they have a weak wide receiver room,” McIntyre said. He later added, “You need a star. Puka is a star.” IMPROVE YOUR TEAM: PFN’s Free Fantasy Trade Calculator However, Nacua’s availability remains uncertain. He is recovering from MCL surgery after suffering MCL and PCL sprains and turf toe against Washington on Nov. 8. The procedure is expected to keep him out for a couple of months, likely ending his 2026 season after seven games, in which he recorded 70 catches for 715 yards and four touchdowns. He ranks 9th in PFN NFL WR Impact Score with a grade of 84, a metric led by the one and only Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Nacua’s contract situation has also become complicated by a three-game suspension without pay for violating the NFL’s personal conduct policy. The league reportedly warned him that another violation could bring more severe discipline. Nacua is scheduled to become an unrestricted free agent in 2027 after playing out his four-year, $4.08 million rookie contract. The Rams could still negotiate an extension, use the projected $30.9 million franchise tag, or explore a tag-and-trade. However, Los Angeles also has several other players approaching free agency, including Davante Adams, Kobie Turner and Byron Young. So, for now, the Raiders and Dolphins are simply potential destination

item.title: Manchester United set to rival Tottenham Hotspur for £50m Bundesliga striker as axed Spurs forward nears £10m exit
item.description: Sport-Club Freiburg v VfL Wolfsburg - DFB Cup 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Manchester United are set to rival Tottenham Hotspur for £50 million-rated Freiburg striker Igor Matanovic during the January transfer window. Meanwhile, out-of-favour Spurs forward Richarlison is closing in on a £10m departure after drawing renewed interest from Turkish side Trabzonspor. Super Lig club revive pursuit According to The i Paper , Tottenham are now ready to accept around £10m for Richarlison, who is open to moving to the Turkish Super Lig . Summer interest from Vasco da Gama, Trabzonspor and former club Everton previously stalled over "financial obstacles". Left out of Roberto De Zerbi's 25-man squad and last seen playing for the U21s in the Jersey Mike's Trophy, he now awaits talks over wages and regular starts. Struggling frontline forces recruitment search Although omitting the Brazilian was not De Zerbi's call, the Spurs boss publicly chided him for "sometimes wanting to leave" , prompting Richarlison to share comments from ex-Everton forward Duncan Ferguson on Instagram stating "you don't leave a player like that out" . Following his request to move on, Omar Marmoush arrived on loan from Manchester City with a £60m buy option, yet the Egyptian has scored just one Premier League goal this season, matching Dominic Solanke's tally. That lack of firepower has left Tottenham searching for a new centre-forward in January. The report states that Freiburg's Croatia international Matanovic is being monitored, though Mauricio Pochettino's United are also keen as the German club prepare to demand £50m . Alternative targets attract fierce competition Should Spurs look elsewhere, the outlet notes that Eli Junior Kroupi is fit again after missing three months with a foot injury, though Arsenal, Barcelona and Liverpool are also tracking him. Real Madrid's Endrick is another name back on Premier League radars after logging just 147 minutes since Jose Mourinho's return, although only a January loan appears possible. Elsewhere in north London, Chelsea loanee Mykhailo Mudryk remains two weeks from fitness and sparked controversy on a Ukrainian podcast by admitting he "wanted to join Arsenal", calling the Emirates his "dream" move. He also blamed international duty for his positive drugs test , drawing a furious demand for an apology from Ukraine federation chief Andriy Shevchenko. Key absentees return before Ipswich While winter transfer plans take shape, Tottenham's injury crisis is finally easing ahead of their upcoming clash with Ipswich Town. James Maddison and Savio have returned to training and are available alongside Lucas Bergvall and Destiny Udogie, though Mathys Tel remains ruled out. With no agreement yet reached with Trabzonspor, Richarlison's future and Spurs' striker hunt will dominate January discussions.

item.title: Now made public the truth about the Arsenal ‘multiple bids’ for Bruno Guimarães
item.description: Bruno Guimaraes subs bench It was the story of the summer, Bruno Guimarães moving from Newcastle United to Arsenal. It was a saga that went on for weeks and weeks. It felt like far longer than that. For Newcastle United fans , this Bruno Guimarães to Arsenal saga felt very similar to the previous summer’s Alexander Isak to Liverpool one. With the summer 2026 episode of transfer window torture, so much of it was played out in the media, claim and counter claim. Now on the day that Bruno Guimarães returns with Arsenal to St James’ Park, there has been a media exclusive on ‘What really happened with Arsenal’s ‘multiple bids’?’ Luke Edwards at The Telegraph giving this insight into what happened, stating: ‘It was the saga of the summer, with constant reports and claims from so-called experts that Arsenal made multiple bids for Guimarães that were rejected by Newcastle. The truth can be revealed now.’ In his exclusive, Luke Edwards gives the following step by step detail of what happened with the Bruno Guimarães ‘multiple bids’ from Arsenal saga… Step One ‘In July, Newcastle were shown a written offer from Arsenal by an intermediary. It was official looking, complete with Arsenal branding and said they would be willing to pay £45m for Newcastle’s captain.’ Step Two ‘It was this document that was used to justify the constant stream of reports saying a bid had been made. Newcastle, though, were bemused. Not only was the fee offered derisory, but when they asked Arsenal to confirm the bid, they were greeted with silence for weeks. As a result, Newcastle dismissed it and maintained their “no bids” stance.’ Step Three ‘It is believed by some well-placed sources that the document had been acquired to pacify Guimarães, who was angry about the lack of progress being made. His representatives wanted to prove to him that Arsenal’s interest was genuine and they were working hard on his behalf. However, it was the key part of a tactic to feed into media pressure on Newcastle to sell.’ Step Four ‘There were no direct conversations between the clubs until the end of July. Even then, Arsenal continued to discuss numbers around the £50m mark, adding performance-related add-ons which Newcastle told them were unacceptable.’ Step Five ‘At the start of August, with Guimarães’s return to pre-season training looming and growing concern he could stay away, Newcastle issued an ultimatum. They would accept an offer of £75m paid in full, with no clauses. If Arsenal were not willing to pay it, Guimarães would not be sold. A deal was struck.’ This update fits in very much with what I have thought all along. Whatever people want to believe about Bruno Guimarães, to me it was Arsenal to blame for most of this mess that blighted Newcastle United across summer 2026. If they had done things professionally from the start, it could and would have been a transfer that progressed very differently, rather than an embarrassing mess. item.title: “Have High Expectations for This Group”: Defiant Mark Pope Reveals What Needs to Change at Kentucky as Fans Question His HC Position
item.description: Mark Pope. © Imagn Kentucky Wildcats head coach Mark Pope spoke to the media after the 14-point road loss to the Indiana Hoosiers. It was Kentucky’s second loss in six games and had fans calling for the coach to be replaced. Pope was asked what needs to change for the program to return to its usual competitive standard after a string of disappointing performances. “We just have to get better every day, and that’s what this team is built to do,” Pope said. “This group is gonna be relentless in terms of growing and improving. They have a really high ceiling, and we’re not close to it right now. So there are no magic pills. We’re not chasing that. This is like a daily commitment. That’s how you become great, and that’s what this team’s committed to doing. That’s what I expect us to see.” Pope acknowledged that he has a young team, but that’s not an ‘excuse’. “So I have high expectations for this group,” Pope added. “This is not the way we wanted to start the season, the first six games. But we are learning and growing, and we’re taking in a ton of data and experience, and these guys are learners and growers. So I expect great things out of this group.” The Wildcats need improvements on defense, especially rebounding, which was a crucial factor in the 90-76 loss to Indiana. Mark Pope’s Kentucky Suffers Worst Loss To Indiana In Two Decades The 90-76 defeat was Kentucky’s worst loss against the Hoosiers since 2007, when it lost 70-51. The biggest reasons behind Kentucky’s defeat were a porous defense, fouls, and a lack of bench production. Indiana’s 28 successful free throws proved decisive. The Hoosiers also scored 33 points off the bench compared to just four for Kentucky. Despite the loss, Milan Momcilovic emerged as a bright spot for Kentucky, as the 6-foot-9 big man finished with 28 points on 10-of-16 shooting, including five three-pointers. Zoom Diallo contributed 15 points, Alex Wilkins added 13, and Malachi Moreno scored 12. However, no other Kentucky player scored more than four points. Kentucky faces Wichita State and Virginia in its next two games as it looks to steady the ship after a challenging start. item.title: Who is supporting Gianni Infantino and how many votes will secure re-election as Fifa president?
item.description: Gianni Infantino is facing a battle to cling onto his Fifa presidency heading into next year’s election after his botched bid to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors resulted in a significant loss in support. England and Wales have been among the football associations to join European governing body Uefa in leading the charge for Infantino’s removal from power, formally withdrawing their endorsement of the Swiss-Italian for re-election in March 2027 . But as the dust has settled on his privatisation ploy, Infantino’s bid for a third term has strengthened. His allies have surfaced, with the likes of Mexico and Argentina joining Caf , the African football governing body, in reaffirming support for the under-fire president, and now the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has reversed its position and backed Infantino with AFC president Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa underlining that there is “a true understanding between us”. Infantino does have his challengers, with French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo and Japan Football Association honorary president Kozo Tashima joining the race. The deadline to submit presidential bids passed on 18 November. But Infantino, confident of staying on for a fourth term, laughed in response to a question over whether he had considered resigning as president, declaring he retains the support of the “vast, vast majority” of world football. Infantino needs 106 votes from the 211 member associations to be re-elected as president . Here is every country and confederation to have expressed their opposition or support for Infantino: Who is opposing Infantino? Uefa (55 members) 🇪🇺 Uefa, the governing body for Europe, has staunchly opposed Infantino’s leadership. They threatened a boycott of Fifa competitions before Infantino’s eventual climbdown but has continued to assert that his position is untenable, even taking legal action against the Swiss-Italian. The body points to how there have not been “assurances” that attempts like the privatisation of the World Cup “to disfigure the game in this way will never be made again”. Uefa general secretary Theodore Theodoridis has written to his Fifa counterpart Mattias Grafstrom setting out a series of questions on behalf of European members of the Fifa Council, demanding documents covering a series of Infantino controversies. Fifa has until 2 November to answer these questions. Concacaf (41 members) 🌎 Concacaf, the Confederation for North America and the Caribbean, came out in opposition of Infantino after being left stunned at the lack of consultation during the Fifa sell-off plan, which they went on to reject. After the plan was aborted, the confederation said: “This recent unilateral and egregious act of poor governance and leadership follows a pattern of missteps and similar behaviour. A comprehensive reckoning with this presidency is imperative.” Concacaf president Victor Montagliani was initially seen as a front-runner to challenge Infantin

item.title: Premier League Report Cards: Grading all 20 teams after 10 Games
item.description: Premier League Report Cards: Grading all 20 teams after 10 Games With 10 games of the Premier League season played, the early picture is beginning to take shape. Some teams have exceeded expectations, others have fallen short, and a few are still searching for consistency. We've graded all 20 Premier League clubs on their performances so far. Arsenal - A+ Mikel Arteta will have few complaints about how the champions have started their title defence. A blip at Brighton aside, Arsenal have been near flawless, opening up a five-point lead. An unbeaten start in the Champions League adds to the promise, with the Gunners looking every bit the team to beat this season. Aston Villa - B Unai Emery deserves huge credit for how he has handled significant squad surgery in the summer. Aston Villa lost six starters from their Europa League final win in May, but an exciting new side have impressed. Nicolas Jackson, Zion Suzuki and Johan Manzambi all look superb signings, with Villa improving from a tough start to build momentum. Bournemouth - A Bournemouth are another side that have handled transition brilliantly, as Marco Rose has continued on the good work from Andoni Iraola. The Cherries are chasing Europe again, and headed into the international break on a run of eight consecutive wins. That included 3-0 thrashings of AC Milan, Manchester United and Aston Villa. Brentford - B That Brentford sit comfortably in the top half, with barely anyone mentioning it, is a testament to the club's progress. On one of the lowest budgets in the league, Brentford keep exceeding expectations. Brighton - A+ Brighton have arguably been the most attractive team in the Premier League this season and are currently Arsenal's closest challengers in the title race. The Seagulls have been superb, scoring a league-leading 26 goals under Fabian Hurzeler and claiming the scalps of Arsenal and Man City. Pascal Gross continues to age like a fine wine in midfield. Chelsea - B- As Forrest Gump would say, Chelsea are like a box of chocolates; you never know what you're going to get. Xabi Alonso's unpredictable side have fluctuated from excellent to ordinary. The Blues badly need some defensive leaders. Coventry City - C- Coventry are 17th in the Premier League table. If the Sky Blues end the season there, it will be a job well done for Frank Lampard. Investment might be required in January to do so. Crystal Palace - E After consecutive seasons winning long-awaited major trophies, Crystal Palace now find themselves sucked into the danger zone. Bottom of the table, Pierre Sage has been sacked and Thomas Frank has arrived. His first job will be fixing the league's worst defence. Everton - B+ Many tipped the Toffees for a season of struggle after David Moyes failed to get late signings over the line, but the Blues sit sixth after 10 games. item.title: The Governor, The Candidate And The Voter
item.description: Anambra puts the power of endorsements to the test, while opposition negotiations and election safeguards face approaching deadlines. On Thursday in Awka, Governor Chukwuma Soludo presented APGA’s flag to Vice-President Kashim Shettima, who received it on behalf of President Bola Tinubu. On Friday, Peter Obi took his campaign through Onitsha, attracting supporters ahead of his town hall engagement. Two neighbouring cities offered competing pictures of political strength. In Awka, the message was partnership with the centre. In Onitsha, Obi demonstrated his continuing ability to mobilise in the state he once governed. The electoral question lies between those pictures: how far can a governor’s endorsement move presidential votes, and how effectively can a candidate convert personal loyalty into turnout? Anambra will help answer both. Soludo’s Wager APGA’s support gives Tinubu an organised partner outside the APC. Soludo is making an argument about the South-East’s place in national politics: that cooperation with the President offers a route to influence and development. The presentation reaffirmed APGA’s presidential alignment while the party continues pursuing its own interests in other elections. For Tinubu, the opportunity lies in improving his reach through a political organisation rooted in the state. For Soludo, the challenge is to persuade people who support his governorship to make the same choice in a presidential contest. Those loyalties need not coincide. Voters can approve of a governor’s performance and prefer another presidential candidate. They can also reconsider a previous choice if a new alliance offers a convincing case. The evidence will emerge through sustained mobilisation, local organisation and ultimately the ballot. A flag presentation establishes an endorsement. It cannot establish the electorate’s response. Obi’s Home-State Test Obi’s Onitsha road show supplies evidence of campaign activity and visible support. It does not, on its own, measure the balance of opinion across Anambra. His task is to maintain that support while building sufficient reach elsewhere. The home-state contest also brings his governing record into sharper focus. Obi has chosen to defend that record publicly; Soludo is advancing a different argument about Anambra’s political interests. Voters deserve an exchange grounded in verifiable achievements, present needs and credible proposals. Claims that cooperation necessarily delivers prosperity or that popular enthusiasm guarantees victory require testing. Anambra’s significance extends beyond its presidential tally. It offers a clear case study in the relationship between party machinery, a governor’s influence and a candidate’s personal following.
